tasks.description: Review the supplied pricing function against this complete local contract: every direct call must reject a nonfinite or negative unitPrice, and reject a noninteger or negative quantity, regardless of callers. For accepted inputs, JavaScript Math.round(unitPrice * quantity * 100) / 100 is the specified arithmetic rule. Alternative currency standards, transaction limits, and caller reachability are outside this review. Identify violations of this contract from the supplied source, with exact evidence. Report any missing fact actually needed for these scoped conclusions.
acceptance: Check enforcement of the complete supplied validation contract at the function boundary without relying on callers.
Treat the stated arithmetic rule as the local specification; do not infer an unspecified financial policy or claim wider financial correctness.

tasks.description: Review the supplied pagination function against this complete local contract: for a plain array and positive integer page and pageSize, page is one-based and the result contains at most pageSize elements starting at (page - 1) * pageSize, preserving order and leaving the input unchanged. A start past the array end returns an empty array. A non-array input or non-positive/noninteger page parameter is rejected. External callers, UI behavior and persistence are outside this task. Identify source-grounded violations of this contract and any fact actually required but missing.
acceptance: Check the stated one-based page contract across valid plain-array inputs and the declared invalid parameter cases.
Cite exact supplied source evidence; scope conclusions to the function and the provided contract.
